about: Morax Luxury Detailing (Instagram display name 'Top Detailing & Luxury Services', Facebook 'Morax Car Wash & auto detailing') is a Doral-area mobile/garage-bay detailing operation. Real photos from their own Instagram feed show foam-cannon washes, hand washing, machine paint polishing and wheel/tire cleaning performed on a wide range of vehicles: a yellow Ferrari, a dark blue Rolls-Royce Wraith, a Porsche 911, a Kia sedan, a lifted black pickup and a lifted Jeep Wrangler, all shot in the same covered multi-level parking garage bay in the Doral area. This vehicle variety (everyday cars through exotics and lifted trucks) is the basis for the site's 'everyday cars to exotics' positioning; nothing here is inferred beyond what the photos show.

reviews_note: No verbatim, individually-attributed review quotes could be verified for this specific business. Direct fetches of Yelp (m.yelp.com, www.yelp.com/biz/morax-luxury-detailing-miami), chamberofcommerce.com and wheree.com all returned HTTP 403 when attempted directly (curl and WebFetch). WebSearch summaries of those same pages surfaced only aggregate numbers ('Morax Car Wash has a 4.9 star rating from 152 reviewers' per chamberofcommerce.com), not individual quotes with names. Rather than reuse quotes found for a different, unrelated business (Milanesi Car Wash & Detailing, a different Doral detailer, turned up in adjacent searches with its own named reviews), this build uses social_proof.modo = 'razones' (3 real reasons derived from the actual photo evidence and contact model), per the adapted-variant rule for when no verbatim reviews are verifiable.
review_count_note: WebSearch summary of chamberofcommerce.com's business directory page for 'Morax Car Wash' stated '4.9 star rating from 152 reviewers'. Presented on-site as '4.9 . 150+ Google reviews' (rounded down, not the precise 152) since the underlying page could not be independently refetched to confirm the exact figure firsthand; both the 4.9 rating and 150+ review count clear the config.json thresholds (>=4.5 rating, >=10 reviews) with margin.
language_source: No verbatim captions or reviews in Spanish or English were recoverable (IG captions returned by the Railway service were generic auto-generated 'Video by Top Detailing & Luxury Services on <date>' strings, not real user captions). Language chosen as English based on: the business's own chosen English display name/branding ('Top Detailing & Luxury Services', 'Morax Luxury Detailing'), and the English-language Yelp/Chamber of Commerce/wheree.com listings found. No stronger Spanish signal was found despite the Doral/Miami-Dade market skewing bilingual.
research_degradado_note: Photos came via the Railway ig_photos-style service inside research_ig.py (local Playwright failed with ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, a known sandbox limitation per task brief). That service only returns photo URLs + generic captions, not the profile bio/header, so bio_raw, email, phone, followers and posts fields in the raw research_ig.py output are null. Phone number and rating/review data used on the site were instead independently verified via WebSearch summaries of Yelp/Chamber of Commerce listings (see phone_source, review_count_note), not invented.

brand_vibe: No dedicated logo exists. Real photos show foam-wash action (white/pink foam) against a covered concrete parking-garage bay with distinctive red safety pipes overhead, worked on everything from a yellow Ferrari to a lifted black truck. This reads as gritty, hands-on and premium-automotive rather than soft/spa-like: a near-black base with a deep crimson/red accent (echoing both the garage's red safety pipes and the pink foam-cannon fluid visible in several photos) fits better than a warm gold palette used on unrelated builds.
